title: Review repairs (docs and claims): Phase 0 diff asserts enforcement the tree does not have
description:
Final review of epic 692 (no blockers). Fix these SIX should-fix items plus the batched nits, all small edits. Do not change any contracts/*.json fixture (a sibling tick owns fixture changes and the bundle bump; if you must touch contracts/CHANGELOG.md or README.md prose, expect to merge with it — keep both).
1. cloud/factory/test/phase0-compat.test.ts:876-911 FALLBACK_REPORTS claims to pin cloud/sandbox/worker.sh report lines verbatim but feeds its own literals; it has already drifted (test:892 vs worker.sh:881). Make the test READ worker.sh and extract the literals (or a shared constant both import) so drift fails. Same pattern at :649-654 (wrangler.toml containers name compared to a literal): read wrangler.toml. The revoke-before-destroy ordering test (1182-1219) uses its own on_cancel callback; either exercise run-workflow.ts:2340 wiring / finalize ordering (3047->3162) or rename the test to say what it actually pins.
2. contracts/README.md:50-56, internal/contracts/bundle.go:19-21, root CHANGELOG.md bundle bullet all claim a re-cut without a version bump goes red; nothing enforces it (Verify compares digests only; contracts.mjs compares version to pin; both unchanged after a re-cut). Either implement the check (e.g. bundle.json records the digest of its own digests map under the version, and a re-cut that changes files without changing version fails Verify in Go and verifyBundle in TS, with negative controls) or reword all three to "discipline, enforced by review". Prefer implementing it; it is small.
3. contracts/README.md:278-282 and root CHANGELOG.md:44 say both readers grep run-workflow.ts for symbols; only Go does (lifecycle/contract_test.go:326-351); the vitest reader runs in workerd with no fs. Fix the wording (repo-wiki/lifecycle-invariants-suite.md:111 has it right).
4. Root CHANGELOG.md run-state bullet still describes 1.2.0 state (two evidence shapes, nothing fails); tree is 2.1.0 with one record and cross-file tests. Rewrite it, add the missing 2.0.0 (atx) entry, fix "sixteen negative examples" (now 18).
6. docs/projects/2026-09-01-ticfac-architecture/credentials.md:21-28 vs contracts/credential-ownership.json ownership[]: MD omits deployment (holds factory_token) and adds "Source Git access" with no fixture entry. Make the MD table match the fixture exactly and add a Go test in internal/factory/credentials that parses the MD table and compares it to ownership[] so they cannot drift.
7. contracts/CHANGELOG.md:155 "Every provenance field is required and nullable" is false: run_id, source_ref, source_sha are plain string and phase a bare $ref; ten of fourteen are nullable, which is the correct reading of SPEC §10.1. Fix the sentence, not the schema.
Nits (batch): 14 ci.yml named contract step omits internal/factory/jobprotocol, runstate, lifecycle and cmd/tk/cmd — add them; its comment says Go re-hashes against the version cloud/factory pins, but Go never reads contracts.pin.json — fix the comment. 15 cloud/factory/CONTRACTS.md stale counts ("thirteen imports", "nine JSON files", bundleVersion 1.0.0 example, "eight different ways"). 16 "ten of the thirteen name a run-workflow.ts symbol" — all 13 do (root CHANGELOG:44, lifecycle-invariants.test.ts:145-148, wiki page). 17 contracts/README.md:3-7 "every one describes a format ticks owns" — three are ticfac-owned. 18 repo-wiki/cross-language-contracts.md verified_against predates its own edit; timeline lacks 1.1.0 and job-protocol entries. 19 cloud/factory/test/lifecycle-harness.ts:446-457 compares via JSON.stringify on unsorted objects — sort keys. 20 add one sentence to tk-json-manifest.json request.$comment: enforceJSONContract runs in PersistentPreRunE for every command incl. merge drivers, so a bad TK_JSON_CONTRACT in a shell env makes git merges exit 11 (by design). (This last one edits a contract JSON: coordinate — it is a $comment-only change; do it and note that the sibling bumps the bundle; if the sibling has not, bump PATCH yourself.)
Run in the FOREGROUND: go test -short ./internal/contracts/ ./internal/factory/... ./cmd/tk/..., cloud/factory pnpm contracts:check, pnpm contracts:test, pnpm exec tsc --noEmit, pnpm exec vitest run test/phase0-compat.test.ts test/lifecycle-invariants.test.ts.
acceptance_criteria: Each numbered item above is addressed with the stated mechanism (1: the compat test reads worker.sh and wrangler.toml; 2: re-cut-without-bump is either enforced with negative controls on both sides or every claim of it is reworded; 6: an MD-vs-fixture test exists); the listed commands pass; no contract schema semantics changed.
